title: Fish max size: can the wiki MAX be caught on every map?
basis: Thai ROM read in Ghidra, proven by fish-max-size-rom.test.ts and fish-quest-size-rom.test.ts (poo local, headless browser core).

rules.cap: The inn refill (03:838B..85C5; one copy per area, $085A 7..12 = maps 1..6) grows a picked cell by 1; max-1 becomes max, max becomes 0 (removed). max is the fish record +1 ($11EC from 03:8042). No per-map, per-cell, season or time cap exists.
rules.newFish: An empty picked cell gets floor(min/2) + random mod floor(min/2) = floor(min/2) .. 2*floor(min/2)-1 (03:83B0..83C5). The new game fills 1152 of 1536 cells the same way (04:EC56), so no fish starts at or above its record min.
rules.whenGrowth: Only at an inn night (yes to the innkeeper), only in the inn's own map: $0C2E picks (fishing activity, 1..255, then reset to 0 at 03:85C8). Picks walk the 256-byte permutation at 00:EDFA (00:EDE9), so up to 255 different cells per night. Time, sleep at home, map entry, catch and loss do not grow anything (fish-stock-rom.test.ts).
rules.activity: +1 per fight started (01:8019), +2 more when the fish is lost (01:81F8), +3 more when it slips back at the landing (01:927E), +4 per fish handed in (03:A650); capped at 255.
rules.slipBack: A landed fish that slips back (Down at the landing, 01:85FF -> 01:9273) grows by floor(min/16)+1, held at max, and stays in its cell (01:935C..9373).
rules.kept: A kept fish empties its cell (01:8E0B); a lost fish is unchanged except the quest/eel sizes.
rules.pointsPerPass: One pass of a given cell costs on average 256 activity points spent at that map's inn (each point picks one cell of 256).
